sources: VFS Global (Italy visa application centres in Bangladesh)
Italy visa fees in Bangladesh: work, family reunion, study, self-employment (screenshots)
Notice to work visa applicants (5 December 2025)
Return of 4 Bangladeshi citizens on 31 October 2025

facts.c: Italian work visa fee in Bangladesh: BDT 16,240 (EUR 116), or BDT 12,600 (EUR 90) in some cases
VFS Global service charge for an Italian work visa: BDT 5,320 (EUR 38), including 15% VAT
facts.q: Work | VFS Global Service Charge | BDT 5320 | EUR 38

facts.c: Bank draft charge for an Italian visa at VFS: BDT 270
Fingerprints (biometrics) are mandatory for all work visa applicants
facts.q: Work: Biometric is mandatory for all applicants.

facts.c: VFS fees are paid in cash only, at the Embassy's rate of EUR 1 = Tk 140; the VFS charge includes 15% VAT
facts.q: Exchange rate - 1 Euro = 140 VFS service fee is inclusive 15% VAT Mode of Payment: Cash Only

facts.c: The VFS charge covers SMS and email notices, photocopies, photo booth and help filling in the form
facts.q: Logistic fee includes free SMS, e-mail notification, photocopy, photobooth, form filling assistance

facts.c: Family reunion visa: BDT 16,240 (EUR 116) visa fee plus BDT 5,320 (EUR 38) VFS charge and BDT 270 bank draft; children aged 0-12 give no fingerprints
facts.q: Family Re-Union | Visa Fee | BDT 16240 | EUR 116

facts.c: Children aged 0 to 12 are exempt from fingerprints for a family reunion visa
facts.q: Biometric Exemption- Children between 0 to 12 years old are exempted from giving fingerprints.

facts.c: Student visa fee: BDT 7,000 (EUR 50) or free depending on course length; the VFS charge (BDT 5,320) is waived when the visa is free
facts.q: Study | Student Visa Fee | BDT 7000/0 | EUR 50/0

facts.c: The VFS service charge is waived when the Embassy grants the visa free
facts.q: Note: VFS Global service charge is waived when visa fee is gratis by embassy.

facts.c: Self-employment (lavoro autonomo) visa: BDT 16,240 (EUR 116) visa fee plus BDT 5,320 (EUR 38) VFS charge
facts.q: Lavoro Autonomo | Visa Fee | BDT 16240 | EUR 116

facts.c: Holders of a work nulla osta issued or re-confirmed in 2025 must register on the VFS portal vfseu.mioot.com/forms/ITABDE/ and upload the nulla osta copy the employer provides
facts.q: Those who are in possession of a work "Nulla Osta" issued in 2025 or re-confirmed in 2025 must register in the dedicated VFS Global web portal

facts.c: The applicant uploads a copy of the 2025 nulla osta, which the employer in Italy can provide
facts.q: It is necessary to upload copy of the 2025 Nulla Osta, that can be provided by the employer in Italy.

facts.c: The Embassy verifies the nulla osta and gives an appointment within a few days of registration
facts.q: The Embassy will verify the validity of Nulla Osta and provide an appointment in the next few days after the registration.

facts.c: Holders of a 2023-2024 nulla osta who already applied must wait for the review in Italy; VFS contacts them afterwards
facts.q: Those who are in possession of a Nulla Osta issued in 2023-2024 and submitted a visa application already, must wait until a review of their Nulla Osta is completed by the Immigration Office in Italy.

facts.c: On 31 October 2025 Italy returned 4 Bangladeshis without permission to stay; 2 had arrived from Libya without a visa a month before
facts.q: On October 31, Italian Authorities returned from Italy 4 Bangladeshi citizens without authorization to stay.

facts.c: Over 120 Bangladeshis were returned from Italy in 2025 (to 3 November)
facts.q: Over 120 Bangladeshi citizens have already been repatriated to Bangladesh in 2025

facts.c: The Embassy warns that paying traffickers, brokers and dalals to enter without a proper visa, or with a fraudulent one, leads to immediate repatriation
facts.q: Paying traffickers, brokers, and dalals to enter Italy without a proper visa - or with a fraudulent visa - is illegal and will lead to immediate repatriation procedures.
